rows.note: For “very,” 好 is the all-purpose spoken choice before an adjective.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: For certainty, 一定 is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use 正面咁 when describing a constructive or optimistic way of doing something.

example.english: We should face this problem positively.
example.traditional: 我哋要正面咁面對呢個問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing3 min6 gam3 min6 deoi3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use 簡直 for emphatic “absolutely” or “utterly,” especially before a strongly negative or extreme statement.

example.english: This arrangement is positively a disaster.
example.traditional: 呢個安排簡直係一場災難。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6
